preconditions.description: The number of elements n and the number of constraints m are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= li <= ri <= n and 0 <= qi < 2**30 for li, ri, qi in constraints)
preconditions.description: Each constraint (li, ri, qi) satisfies the given bounds.

postconditions.expression: exists(array) such that all((array[li-1] & array[ri-1]) == qi for li, ri, qi in constraints)
postconditions.description: There exists an array that satisfies all the given constraints.
If an array exists, output 'YES' followed by the array elements. Otherwise, output 'NO'.
